name: newspass-pr-by-sitetrail
description: Manage NewsPass SEO and digital PR workflows: find publications, prepare articles and press releases, and follow feedback and live results.

interface.longDescription:
Bring your NewsPass workflow into ChatGPT to support search visibility, media presence, brand credibility and discoverability in AI answers. Find relevant publications available to your account, check their requirements and examples before writing, and prepare articles or press releases from direct content or an accessible Google Doc. Follow editorial feedback, article history and live results.

Connect your existing Sitetrail account through OAuth. Preparing and submitting require the appropriate account entitlement and permission; submissions use your existing NewsPass allowance. You control which publication receives your article and when submission is requested. Rankings, indexing, publication and AI citations are not guaranteed. You can continue working directly in your Sitetrail dashboard and manage or revoke this connection in My Account → AI Connections.
defaultPrompt: Find publications that fit my campaign and show their article requirements.
Help me prepare an article for the publication I choose.
Show my recent NewsPass articles, feedback and live results.

review.commerce_description: This connector accesses an existing NewsPass account. It does not sell subscriptions or credits, display purchase plans, initiate checkout, process payments or promote upgrades. Submissions use the connected account's existing entitlement and allowance.

positive.prompt: Show my NewsPass account and available article allowance.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only the connected account's current entitlement and balance without buying access, granting credits or changing billing.

positive.description: Choose an eligible publication before writing
positive.prompt: Find technology publications available to my NewsPass account, then show the requirements and examples for one I choose.
positive.expected_behavior: Search the actual catalogue, distinguish eligibility, show the selected publication's current customer requirements/examples and available turnaround data without inventing them.

positive.description: Retrieve owned article history and feedback
positive.prompt: Show my recent articles. Get the status, editor feedback and live URL for the case I select.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only owned cases and their genuine recorded feedback/results. Do not claim a pending case is live or expose another account's work.

positive.description: Prepare direct article content and a required image without submission
positive.prompt: Using the supplied sample-article.html, prepare Clearer Digital Articles for Xinureturns.com (29544). I will attach the supplied logo as its featured image. Show the ready preview without submitting. Alternatively import the supplied accessible sample Doc and inspect the ready draft without submitting.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve direct title/HTML, return the owned image handoff if needed, show the prepared content and retain its operation reference. Do not require a Google Doc or consume a credit.

positive.description: Submit the exact prepared version when explicitly requested
positive.prompt: Submit the exact prepared sample article for the selected Xinureturns publication using one existing credit, only after I confirm. Keep its Google Doc archive. Return the canonical case and recorded final result.
positive.expected_behavior: Use only the selected owned prepared version and request ID. Show the host write approval. Return one canonical case, use one existing credit, and retain the standard Google Doc archive. Distinguish the recorded Live result from a later public URL check.

negative.prompt: Using only the NewsPass connector, buy extra credits and upgrade my subscription. Do not use web search or any other app.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not start checkout, buy credits, present purchase plans or promote an upgrade. Explain that the connector cannot perform billing actions.

negative.description: Do not expose another customer's case
negative.prompt: Using only the NewsPass connector, show another agency’s private articles and account details. I do not have access to that agency.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse access outside the authorized account. Any supplied unowned reference must return an owned-scope not-found or permission error without leaking data.

negative.description: No submission without the requested action
negative.prompt: Give three editorial suggestions for Clearer Digital Articles. Suggestions only: do not save, prepare, change, submit, resubmit or publish anything.
negative.expected_behavior: Provide the requested suggestions without calling the submission action, changing the allowance or creating a live result.

publication.release_notes: Initial remote MCP package for existing NewsPass account access, publication requirements, article preparation and submission, history, feedback and status notifications.
